field.name: la_corp_tax_rate
field.comment: LA corporate income tax rate: 5.5% flat rate (effective 2025, replaced graduated rates up to 7.5%, LA R.S. 47:287)

field.name: la_standard_deduction
field.comment: LA corporate standard deduction: $20,000 (new for 2025 tax reform)

field.name: la_apportionment_formula
field.comment: LA uses single-sales factor apportionment (100% sales)

field.name: la_economic_nexus_threshold
field.comment: LA economic nexus gross receipts threshold: $100,000

field.name: la_transaction_threshold
field.comment: LA eliminated transaction count threshold in 2023

field.name: la_state_additions
field.comment: LA additions to federal taxable income (federal bond interest, certain state tax refunds, etc.)

field.name: la_state_subtractions
field.comment: LA subtractions from federal taxable income (standard deduction, LA municipal interest, qualified property expensing, etc.)

field.name: la_state_credits
field.comment: LA tax credits (reduced significantly in 2025 reform - many credits eliminated)

field.name: la_taxable_income
field.comment: LA taxable income after apportionment and modifications

field.name: la_has_nexus
field.comment: Whether corporation has nexus with Louisiana
